overview: Kalaan is a star system in the Mid Rim Territories, within the Churnis Sector, at galactic grid J-7, Documented in the Essential Atlas and StarWars.com galaxy map appendix..
history:
Kalaan appears in galactic surveys spanning the Old Republic, Imperial era, and New Republic periods. Essential Atlas records place the system in Mid Rim Territories.

Trade lanes, sector politics, and regional conflicts shaped Kalaan's role across the nine saga films, live-action series, and expanded lore.
significance: Kalaan is catalogued on the official StarWars.com galaxy map and Essential Atlas appendix as part of the broader Mid Rim Territories chart.
notableEvents: Charted in the Essential Atlas appendix
Listed on the StarWars.com galaxy map
Surveyed as part of Mid Rim Territories sector records
